<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl" style="--base-font: 16px;"><head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>رحلة الكسور العادية | تطبيق تعليمي تفاعلي</title>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin="">
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cairo:wght@400;600;700;800&amp;display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com/3.4.17"></script>
  <style>
    :root {
      --bg-cream: #FAF8F3;
      --card-white: #FFFFFF;
      --primary-teal: #0F3D3E;
      --secondary-teal: #148080;
      --accent-coral: #D96B43;
      --mint-bg: #E6F4EE;
      --mint-border: #1E7E5C;
      --sand-bg: #F4EFE4;
      --border-soft: #E6E1D6;
      --gold-star: #EAB308;
      --base-font: 16px;
    }

    html {
      font-size: var(--base-font);
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
    }

    body {
      font-family: 'Cairo', 'Tajawal', 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Arial, sans-serif;
      background-color: var(--bg-cream);
      color: #1F2937;
      margin: 0;
      min-height: 100vh;
    }

    .frac {
      display: inline-flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      vertical-align: middle;
      line-height: 1.05;
      margin: 0 4px;
      font-weight: 800;
      direction: ltr;
    }
    .frac .num {
      padding: 0 5px 2px;
      border-bottom: 2px solid currentColor;
    }
    .frac .den {
      padding: 2px 5px 0;
    }

    .card-base {
      background: var(--card-white);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-soft);
      border-radius: 20px;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(15, 61, 62, 0.05);
    }

    .btn-primary {
      background-color: var(--primary-teal);
      color: #FFFFFF;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
    }
    .btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) {
      background-color: #145254;
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }
    .btn-primary:disabled {
      opacity: 0.45;
      cursor: not-allowed;
    }

    .btn-coral {
      background-color: var(--accent-coral);
      color: #FFFFFF;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
    }
    .btn-coral:hover:not(:disabled) {
      background-color: #c25934;
    }

    .hotspot-btn {
      position: absolute;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
      transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
    }
    .hotspot-btn:hover {
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.12);
    }
    .hotspot-active {
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px rgba(217, 107, 67, 0.35);
    }

    @keyframes wavePulse {
      0%, 100% { transform: scaleY(0.4); }
      50% { transform: scaleY(1); }
    }
    .wave-bar {
      width: 4px;
      height: 24px;
      background: #EAB308;
      border-radius: 99px;
      transform-origin: center;
    }
    .playing .wave-bar {
      animation: wavePulse 0.8s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    .playing .wave-bar:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.15s; }
    .playing .wave-bar:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.3s; }
    .playing .wave-bar:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 0.45s; }
    .playing .wave-bar:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: 0.2s; }
    .playing .wave-bar:nth-child(6) { animation-delay: 0.35s; }

    :focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #9b3414 !important; outline-offset: 4px; }
    button, select, input:not([type="checkbox"]):not([type="range"]) { min-height: 44px; }
    input[type="checkbox"] { width: 22px; height: 22px; }
    .skip-link { position: fixed; top: -100px; right: 12px; z-index: 100; padding: 12px; background: #fff; color: #111; }
    .skip-link:focus { top: 8px; }
    .sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0,0,0,0); white-space: nowrap; }
    body.easy-reading #stageContainer p, body.easy-reading #stageContainer label { font-size: 1.1rem !important; line-height: 2 !important; }
    body.easy-reading #stageContainer button { font-size: 1rem !important; }
    body.focus-learning .welcome-cover, body.focus-learning aside { display: none; }
    .focus-title { display: none; }
    body.focus-learning .focus-title { display: block; }
    body.focus-learning main { grid-column: 1 / -1; max-width: 900px; width: 100%; margin: auto; }
    body.high-contrast, body.high-contrast #stageContainer, body.high-contrast header, body.high-contrast aside, body.high-contrast section, body.high-contrast [role="dialog"] > div { background: #fff !important; color: #111 !important; }
    body.high-contrast #stageContainer :not(img):not(svg):not(svg *), body.high-contrast aside *, body.high-contrast #accessibilityModal *, body.high-contrast header * { color: #111 !important; border-color: #111 !important; }
    body.high-contrast button, body.high-contrast input, body.high-contrast select { background: #fff !important; color: #111 !important; border: 2px solid #111 !important; }
    body.high-contrast button:disabled { opacity: 0.6; }
    body.reduce-motion *, body.reduce-motion *::before, body.reduce-motion *::after { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; } }
    @media (max-width: 420px) { #stageContainer { padding: 12px; } header button { min-width: 44px; } }

    body { padding-bottom: 145px; }
    #kasroonDock { position: fixed; bottom: max(14px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); left: 18px; z-index: 35; display: flex; align-items: end; gap: 6px; max-width: min(280px, calc(100vw - 28px)); pointer-events: none; }
    #kasroonDock[hidden] { display: none; }
    #kasroonButton { width: 100px; height: 123px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; pointer-events: auto; filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 4px #0f3d3e22); }
    .kasroon-art { width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: visible; }
    .kasroon-bubble { pointer-events: none; background: #fff; border: 2px solid #148080; border-radius: 18px 18px 18px 4px; padding: 8px 12px; color: #0F3D3E; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 28px; max-width: 155px; box-shadow: 0 3px 12px #0f3d3e12; }
    .kasroon-bubble span { display: block; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; margin-top: 3px; }
    @keyframes kasroonHop { 0% { transform: translate(0,0) rotate(0); } 25% { transform: translate(20px,-48px) rotate(10deg); } 55% { transform: translate(0,0) rotate(-6deg); } 75% { transform: translate(0,-17px) rotate(3deg); } 100% { transform: translate(0,0) rotate(0); } }
    #kasroonButton.kasroon-hop { animation: kasroonHop .85s ease-out; }
    #kasroonModal .kasroon-portrait { width: 95px; height: 110px; flex-shrink: 0; }
    #kasroonModal .kasroon-help-button { padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid #c4dfd5; border-radius: 14px; background: #fff; color: #0F3D3E; font-size: .9rem; font-weight: 800; text-align: right; }
    #kasroonModal .kasroon-help-button:hover { background: #E6F4EE; }
    body.focus-learning .kasroon-bubble { display: none; }
    body.high-contrast #kasroonButton { background: transparent !important; border: none !important; }
    @media (max-width: 480px) { #kasroonDock { left: 10px; } #kasroonButton { width: 78px; height: 98px; } .kasroon-bubble { max-width: 135px; font-size: 11px; } }
    .calm-button { cursor:pointer; border:1px solid #D5DFD6; background:#fff; color:#254944; padding:10px 15px; border-radius:13px; min-height:44px; font-size:.8rem; font-weight:800; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; }

    .island-map { isolation:isolate; }
    .island-route { position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; pointer-events:none; z-index:1; }
    .island-map .hotspot-btn { z-index:2; }
    .map-pin-label { position:absolute; top:calc(100% + 5px); left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%); white-space:nowrap; font-size:11px; font-weight:800; padding:3px 8px; border-radius:999px; background:#fff; color:#0F3D3E; box-shadow:0 2px 8px #0f3d3e25; }
    .map-pin-check { position:absolute; top:-7px; right:-7px; width:22px; height:22px; border-radius:50%; display:grid; place-items:center; font-size:12px; background:#1E7E5C; color:#fff; border:2px solid white; }
    @keyframes islandArrival { 0% {box-shadow:0 0 0 0 #D96B4380;} 100% {box-shadow:0 0 0 16px #D96B4300;} }
    .island-map .hotspot-active { animation:islandArrival .7s ease-out; }
    .map-passport { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px; align-items:center; }
    .map-stamp { display:inline-flex; gap:6px; align-items:center; border:1px dashed #B9CEBC; padding:7px 10px; border-radius:12px; font-size:12px; color:#536B60; background:white; }
    .map-stamp.done { border:1px solid #1E7E5C; color:#1E7E5C; background:#E6F4EE; }
    .map-mission { padding:20px; border-radius:20px; border:1px solid #C6DFD2; background:#F0F7F1; }
    .map-pieces { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(44px,1fr)); gap:8px; max-width:400px; margin:18px auto; }
    .map-piece { min-height:56px; border:2px solid #9EB9A8; background:#fff; border-radius:12px; color:#496C5C; font-size:18px; font-weight:800; }
    .map-piece[aria-pressed="true"] { background:#148080; border-color:#0F3D3E; color:white; }
    .map-piece:disabled { opacity:.9; }
    .map-mission-feedback { min-height:26px; line-height:1.7; font-size:14px; font-weight:700; color:#0F3D3E; }
    .island-certificate { padding:18px; text-align:center; border:1px solid #E2BD5C; border-radius:18px; background:#FFF9E5; color:#6C4A0B; }
    body.high-contrast .map-mission,body.high-contrast .map-stamp { background:#fff; color:#111; border:2px solid #111; }
    body.high-contrast .map-piece[aria-pressed="true"] { background:#111 !important; color:#fff !important; }
    @media(max-width:480px) { .map-pin-label {font-size:10px;padding:2px 5px;} .island-map .hotspot-btn {width:44px;height:44px;font-size:22px;} .map-mission {padding:14px;} }

    .listening-story { border:1px solid #D5E3D7; border-radius:22px; overflow:hidden; background:#F1F7EF; }
    .listening-story svg { display:block; width:100%; height:auto; max-height:300px; }
    .story-moving-piece { transform-box:view-box; transform-origin:320px 155px; transition:transform .8s ease-in-out,fill .6s ease; }
    .story-chocolate-piece { transition:transform .8s ease-in-out,fill .6s ease; }
    .story-caption { padding:12px 18px; background:white; color:#0F3D3E; font-size:.9rem; font-weight:800; line-height:1.8; min-height:66px; border-top:1px solid #D5E3D7; }
    .story-controls { display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:10px 14px; background:#FAFCF7; border-top:1px solid #E0E8DC; }
    .story-controls button { min-height:44px; border:1px solid #CADBCF; border-radius:12px; background:white; padding:8px 12px; font-size:.8rem; font-weight:800; color:#0F3D3E; }
    .story-dots { display:flex; gap:5px; }
    .story-dots button { padding:4px; min-width:32px; border:0; background:transparent; }
    .story-dot { display:block;width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:#C0D4C4;margin:auto; }
    .story-dots button[aria-current="step"] .story-dot {background:#D96B43;}
    .story-character-arm { transform-origin:center; }
    body.reduce-motion .story-moving-piece,body.reduce-motion .story-chocolate-piece { transition:none !important; }
    body.high-contrast .story-caption,body.high-contrast .story-controls {background:#fff;color:#111;}
    @media(max-width:480px){.story-caption{font-size:.8rem;padding:10px 12px;}.story-controls{padding:8px;gap:5px;}.story-controls button{padding:7px;font-size:.7rem;}.story-dots button{min-width:26px;}}

    @keyframes kasroonSpeakingJump {
      0%,100% {transform:translateY(0) scale(1,1);}
      10% {transform:translateY(0) scale(1.08,.9);}
      38% {transform:translateY(calc(-1 * clamp(70px,17vh,145px))) rotate(-7deg) scale(.96,1.04);}
      55% {transform:translateY(calc(-1 * clamp(70px,17vh,145px))) rotate(6deg);}
      80% {transform:translateY(0) scale(1.08,.9);}
      90% {transform:translateY(-12px) scale(1,1);}
    }
    @keyframes kasroonPortraitJump {
      0%,100% {transform:translateY(0);}
      12% {transform:translateY(0) scale(1.05,.94);}
      40%,52% {transform:translateY(-50px) rotate(-5deg);}
      80% {transform:translateY(0) scale(1.05,.94);}
    }
    body.kasroon-speaking #kasroonButton .kasroon-art {animation:kasroonSpeakingJump 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;transform-origin:50% 90%;}
    #kasroonModal .kasroon-portrait {height:160px;padding-top:50px;box-sizing:border-box;}
    body.kasroon-speaking #kasroonModal .kasroon-portrait .kasroon-art {animation:kasroonPortraitJump 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;transform-origin:50% 90%;}
    body.reduce-motion.kasroon-speaking #kasroonButton .kasroon-art,body.reduce-motion.kasroon-speaking #kasroonModal .kasroon-art {animation:none !important;transform:none !important;}
    @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) {body.kasroon-speaking #kasroonButton .kasroon-art,body.kasroon-speaking #kasroonModal .kasroon-art {animation:none !important;transform:none !important;}}

    .welcome-puzzle {background:#FAF4E5;position:relative;border-radius:22px;border:1px solid #DED7C7;overflow:hidden;}
    .welcome-puzzle > img {position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;opacity:.08;pointer-events:none;}
    .welcome-puzzle svg {position:relative;display:block;width:100%;height:auto;isolation:isolate;}
    .welcome-piece {cursor:grab;touch-action:none;outline:none;}
    .welcome-piece:focus-visible > :first-child {stroke:#0F3D3E;stroke-width:5;stroke-dasharray:6 3;}
    .welcome-piece.dragging {cursor:grabbing;filter:drop-shadow(0 6px 6px #0F3D3E55);}
    .welcome-piece {transition:filter .2s;}
    .welcome-puzzle-actions {position:relative;display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:12px 16px;border-top:1px solid #DFD9CA;background:#FFFCF3;}
    .welcome-puzzle-actions button {border:1px solid #CFD9C8;background:white;color:#0F3D3E;border-radius:12px;padding:8px 13px;min-height:44px;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;}
    .welcome-puzzle-guide {position:relative;margin:0;padding:12px 16px 0;font-size:13px;line-height:1.8;color:#365C51;font-weight:700;}
    .welcome-puzzle-title {padding:16px;background:#0F3D3E;color:white;}
    .welcome-puzzle-title h2 {font-size:1.3rem;font-weight:800;}
    body.high-contrast .welcome-puzzle,body.high-contrast .welcome-puzzle-actions {background:white;}
    @media(max-width:520px){.welcome-puzzle-guide{font-size:11px;}.welcome-puzzle-actions{padding:10px;gap:6px;}.welcome-puzzle-actions button{font-size:11px;padding:7px 10px;}}

    .journey-welcome-title {display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:8px 0;}
    .journey-welcome-title h2 {font-size:clamp(1.5rem,3vw,2.1rem);font-weight:800;color:#0F3D3E;line-height:1.6;}
    .denominator-key {border:1px solid #D8E4D8;background:#F4F8F2;border-radius:16px;padding:12px 16px;}
    .denominator-key summary {cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;color:#0F3D3E;}
    .denominator-chips {display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;padding-top:12px;}
    .denominator-chip {display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;background:white;padding:7px 10px;border:1px solid #DCE3D8;border-radius:12px;font-size:12px;color:#244A41;}
    .denominator-dot {width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--den-color);display:inline-block;}
    .passport-grid {display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;}
    .passport-stamp {padding:16px 10px;border:2px dashed #C7D5CA;border-radius:18px;background:#FAFCF8;color:#62746B;min-height:120px;text-align:center;}
    .passport-stamp.earned {border:2px solid #148080;background:#E6F4EE;color:#0F3D3E;}
    .passport-stamp .stamp-icon {font-size:28px;display:block;}
    .passport-stamp strong {font-size:13px;display:block;margin:6px 0;}
    .passport-stamp small {font-size:11px;}
    .passport-mascot {width:85px;height:100px;flex-shrink:0;}
    .certificate-sheet {position:relative;background:#FFFDF4;color:#0F3D3E;border:3px solid #B99B48;outline:1px solid #E1D3A0;outline-offset:-12px;border-radius:22px;padding:40px 30px;text-align:center;overflow:hidden;}
    .certificate-sheet h2 {font-size:2rem;font-weight:800;color:#0F3D3E;}
    .certificate-student {font-size:clamp(1.5rem,3.5vw,2.4rem);font-weight:800;color:#148080;margin:20px 0;}
    .certificate-rosette {font-size:38px;}
    .graduation-header {display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:18px;}
    .graduation-mascot {width:105px;height:160px;padding-top:45px;box-sizing:border-box;}
    body.kasroon-speaking .graduation-mascot svg {animation:kasroonPortraitJump 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;}
    .celebration-sprinkles {position:relative;height:0;pointer-events:none;}
    .celebration-sprinkles span {position:absolute;top:-40px;left:calc(var(--i) * 5%);width:8px;height:12px;background:var(--color);opacity:0;}
    @keyframes certificateCelebrate {0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-35px) rotate(0);}15%{opacity:1;}100%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(190px) rotate(250deg);}}
    body.celebrating .celebration-sprinkles span {animation:certificateCelebrate 2.3s ease-out both;animation-delay:calc(var(--i) * .025s);}
    body.reduce-motion .graduation-mascot svg,body.reduce-motion .celebration-sprinkles span {animation:none!important;}
    @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.graduation-mascot svg,.celebration-sprinkles span{animation:none!important;}}
    @media print {
      @page {size:A4 landscape;margin:12mm;}
      body.printing-certificate {background:white!important;padding:0!important;}
      body.printing-certificate * {visibility:hidden!important;}
      body.printing-certificate #journeyCertificate,body.printing-certificate #journeyCertificate * {visibility:visible!important;}
      body.printing-certificate #journeyCertificate {position:absolute!important;top:0!important;left:0!important;width:100%!important;min-height:170mm;box-sizing:border-box;box-shadow:none!important;break-inside:avoid;}
      body.printing-certificate #kasroonDock {display:none!important;}
    }
    #stageArrivalPanel[hidden]{display:none!important;}
    #passportModal .passport-mascot {height:150px;padding-top:40px;box-sizing:border-box;}
    body.kasroon-speaking #passportModal .passport-mascot svg {animation:kasroonPortraitJump 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;}
    body.reduce-motion #passportModal .passport-mascot svg {animation:none!important;}
    @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#passportModal .passport-mascot svg {animation:none!important;}}
  </style>
